independent_review: Root review and packaging remain separate; no publication performed by this exporter.
archive_layout: Original outputs/program/... is archive/program/...; all original paths are relative scientific paths.
excluded_categories: Cloud provisioning, costs, authorization, resource inventories and communication records
Private user/machine/runtime operational records, current interactive controls and native/browser captures
Original tar/ZIP retention containers, installed/build caches and compiled profiler artifacts
Remote operational wrapper source with machine-specific behavior
Captured failed-access/challenge responses and populated HTTP form/session records, including their extracted failure text
publication_notes: Exact copies preserve original byte hashes, line endings and privacy-clean original software-format metadata.
Modified exports retain scientific numerical values; 121 individual checkpoint exports remove private machine/environment identity descriptors.
NumPy numerical member bytes were compared before/after; logical Unicode/JSON metadata were inspected after decompression.
Malformed but fully inspectable codec fixtures are retained; unreadable corrupt fixtures and compiled models with private paths remain reference-only.
Historical sensory-map exports retain their runtime group/neuron/optical arrays while omitting restricted companion-table/crosswalk and private operational metadata.
Original source licenses remain separate; NC/ND originals are optional material under their stated terms, with ND file bytes unchanged.
Captured HTTP request/challenge/form-session records are omitted entirely; independent scientific text/data alternatives and original source hashes remain.
